name: Nekomizo Nora
source:
"This kitten's going all-in for the win!"

A bright girl, jolly as a jester. She ends all her sentences like 'Nya', acting in a cat-like manner, and is never to be seen without her mask. Cheerful as she is, she never lets the mask slip. An enigma, all her actions are shrouded in mystery, and nobody can say as to what she's truly thinking.

Flower: Pot Marigold
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [Kyouka no Dangan] —  Can fire flower seeds from her pistol, like bullets.

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Nora_Nekomizo]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
[Description taken from the [url=https://https://mahoumura.com/]Official Site[/url].]
